batch_failure_policy: Persist actual stage/error; no repeat batch, no proxy/DNS changes, no alternate mirror
decision_A_requires: Exact hosted identity linked to official size/hash
decision_B: One bounded clarification review completed but material conditions unresolved; halt tool building and automatic download requests
decision_C_requires: Positive evidence that target cannot meet intended use or lawful acquisition, not silence or connectivity failure
future_schema_application: Only refine after material progress in license and access; otherwise retain J0 plan unexecuted
